notes.title: New secondary weapons and visual updates!
notes.content:
Hi all! We've been working very hard these months, and we’re making every second count. We're implementing a lot of systems and entire visual updates, so we wanted to share some of the things we added to give you a sense of progress! 

[b]A new echo shader and the environment is now entirely 3D! [/b]
[list]
[*] We really wanted to make the echo feel like sound waves, and we really like this direction we’re taking with 3D environments and the sound of "scanning" the area. It made the entire game feel a lot deeper and more immersive! [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1TdKB--pigNYv7GvfUaSWRKpWHVflrA8q/view?usp=drive_link]New echo shader preview[/url]
[/list]
[b]Ultimate move now has starting animation![/b]
[list]
[*] There is no point in making a cool blind ninja game without some awesome animations before executing a killer move so we’ve started our work on creating the unique in which we will represent the ninjas attacks and personality and it really makes the move pop! [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SrJ9Og1dSKzhRBuGZlP2Av_F_RwcUA0J/view?usp=sharing]Ultimate move animation preview[/url]
[/list]
[b]Environmental echolocation tools![/b]
[list]
[*] You can now use the environment to help you in combat and reveal bigger areas and many more uses and utilities! The Gong is my favorite at the moment since it openly invites all enemies to attack you but also reveals the entire room. [url=https://drive.google.com/open?id=1ovfpHn5ssq6KM8YXjory0OSbG-4cBblz&usp=drive_copy]Gong preview[/url]
[/list]
[b]Secondary weapons and loudness![/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve added a few secondary weapons to the game of which i think the most visually interesting one is the Great Club you take from the heavy enemies. It delivers a devastating attack and launches a powerful sound wave making the impact feel even stronger. [url=https://drive.google.com/open?id=1H1f5vwEpBAkRSzXvnr2xBYZsekczpLwO&usp=drive_copy]Heavy weapon preview[/url]
[/list]
That’s just a small part of all the massive system updates we’re making, but this had enough visual appeal to be shown by our pretty rough standards. Also, we’re working on a lot of enemies and environments which we believe we will share very soon so stay tuned. Thank you so much for all of your support as we continue working to make the best echolocation roguelite game ever!

notes.title: We updated our Teaser with new gameplay scenes!
notes.content:
It’s been a busy 3 months since we first launched our Steam page and we’re so happy to see so many people excited for the game so we gave it our all to showcase as much as possible to keep the hype going! 

Here are some new additions to the teaser! 
[list]
[*] Gameplay UI design
[*] Secondary weapons
[*] New enemy types
[*] Boss fight scenes
[/list]
[previewyoutube=FAedTT9dcyA;full][/previewyoutube]

We are so happy for all the support you are giving us and with 13k wishlists in the first 3 months we are excited to share updates on a regular basis.
 
To follow the development in more detail you can join our newsletter where we share art and game updates and give a bigger sneak peek behind the curtains of our development! (info in the steam page description)

Thank you all so much for the support and have an awesome month!
